verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of choosing a cloud region or data-residency location. Community reports do show that Sentry ships a self-hosted deployment, which lets users decide where their data lives and is recommended for legal or compliance needs. Missing for 10: first-party docs on SaaS region selection (e.g. US/EU data residency), first-party self-hosting docs in the pack, and any documented residency guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: A user has run self-hosted Sentry at work for a couple of years and says it has worked fantastically and is rock-solid once running.
They say self-hosting is fine if budgeted and recommend it only for legal or compliance needs.
installation is git clone, editing one or two config files, and running ./install.sh
One team self-hosts Sentry on a high-end Hetzner server (96 cores, 512GB) for about $300/month.
